prompt: A team must choose a message queue. All candidates handle the load easily. By the lesson, what should decide?
hint: Lesson 5: when fit does not separate the options.

choices.text: The newest release, since it carries the latest ideas
choices.why: Novelty is not among the six questions.

choices.text: Skill, ecosystem, licence, cost and exit
choices.why: Right: when every option fits, the decision is about the team and the company.

choices.text: A benchmark at a hundred times the load
choices.why: Fit is already settled; more fit decides nothing.

choices.text: Whatever the architect used at a previous job
choices.why: Personal history is the enthusiasm the lesson weighed against skill on the team.

prompt: Order an architecture decision record's statuses as one record would pass through them when its decision is later replaced.
In Bezos's terms, a decision that is nearly irreversible is a ___ door.
hint: Lesson 5: you cannot walk back through it.

prompt: An ADR's decision section reads: "An event-driven approach will be adopted for delivery notifications." What is wrong with it, by the lesson?
hint: Lesson 5: a sentence somebody can be held to.

choices.text: It is too short to be a decision
choices.why: Length is not the fault; record 7's decision is short too.

choices.text: It should be in the consequences section
choices.why: A decision belongs in the decision section.

choices.text: Its passive voice hides who does what
choices.why: Right: across teams, who publishes and who consumes is the point.

choices.text: Events are a technology, so they belong in a different log
choices.why: The log records structural choices like this one.

prompt: Why did Renata have the old weekly payout batch written up as record 3, years after it was built?
hint: Lesson 5: a decision about to be changed.

choices.text: So its replacement had something to supersede, with its old reasons
choices.why: Right: it records why the batch was right then, and record 7 points at it.

choices.text: Because every system needs a record before it can be changed
choices.why: The lesson backfills the decisions about to change, not every system.

choices.text: To show the batch was a mistake
choices.why: Record 3 says the batch was correct for the company then.

choices.text: Because finance asked for an audit trail of payouts
choices.why: The reason is the decision log, not an audit request.

prompt: A platform engineer proposes adding approvers, a risk matrix and a diagram slot to every decision record. What does the lesson's reasoning suggest?
hint: Lesson 5: what happens to a record that takes a week to write.

choices.text: Adopt it, since more fields make records more complete
choices.why: Completeness that stops records being written is a loss.

choices.text: Adopt it for one-way doors and two-way doors alike
choices.why: Two-way doors need no record at all.
Proposals and records do different jobs.

choices.text: Keep records short, or they get written late as paperwork
choices.why: Right: a record written in an afternoon gets written on the day.
